description: A monophonic pitch track by torchcrepe's tiny CREPE model (pinned by digest; 50 to 1,100 Hz) at a 10 ms step on 16 kHz mono: the pitch, decoded here without torchcrepe's random dither (its Viterbi path, then the probability-weighted mean of the 9 bins around it), and the model's periodicity. A second opinion beside f0-pesto, meant for a vocal stem by --from stems/vocals. Runs under the operator's f0-python, so the archive's environment never imports PyTorch.

parameters.decoder: viterbi path; pitch the probability-weighted mean of the 9 bins around it; no dither

f0.description: one row every 160 samples at 16 kHz (10 ms), columns the pitch in Hz (0 where the tracker gives none) and the model's periodicity, 0 to 1

rows_from_tracker.description: rows the tracker returned before the track was cut, or padded with zeros, to the grid: n // 160 + 1 rows for n samples
